title: Entropic forces and the substrate parameter
html:
Remark. Entropic forces and the substrate parameter

The substrate parameter q (substrate parameter) encodes the coupling between the Levi form and the gauge curvature. In the near-classical regime q \to 1, gravity emerges as a geometric back-reaction (GR substrate geometry). Recent work on the quantum mechanics of entropic forces [carney2025] provides a complementary perspective. The entropic interpretation corresponds to the thermodynamic limit of the q-deformed partition function on the brane tower.
